slice5_decisions: Raster class per the lead decision: image XObject or inline image, chain ends in DCT/JPX/CCITT/JBIG2 after implemented filters. Everything else with an unimplemented filter keeps blocking the proof.

Limit (a) is enforced by the redaction side, not by a proof flag: any image under a region makes the region incomplete (Refuse = typed error, ReportAndContinue = unredacted lists Image/InlineImage, not proven) unless UnsupportedPolicy::RemoveImages removed it whole. RemoveImages still refuses every other unsupported class (vector, shading, deep forms).

Raster streams are still scanned: their decodable prefix is decoded and a plain needle in it (JPEG comment segment) is a hit. Only a needle drawn as pixels is out of reach, and that is what region removal of the image answers.

File targets: /F of remote and launch actions is judged as text or as a file specification; typed file specifications are found anywhere, untyped ones through the action, /FS, /AF and the embedded-file tree (SweepState.fs). /Desc is judged with the names. SubmitForm /Fields and the embedded file CONTENT stay proof hits.
The embedded-file name tree is renamed like /Dests: keys are identifiers nothing refers to, so a matching key becomes an opaque HskRdN and the tree is rebuilt as one sorted leaf.

ToUnicode in the proof: kept page text decoded through a map is a collision, appearance text a hit; the needle text comes from RedactionReport.removed_unicode (font map at removal time) or the PDFDocEncoding reading of the needle bytes. Composite text without a map is listed (opaque_text_streams), not blocking.
Matching normalizes white space and zero-width characters; the byte proof stays an exact-spelling scan, so it is never stricter than the redaction.
slice5_known_gaps: V4-01 is applied to the modules touched in this slice; filters.rs, reader.rs, syntax.rs and writer.rs (the decoders of slices 1-2) do not carry the arithmetic deny yet: suggested next slice (a crate-wide deny was tried and lists many sites; filters.rs alone shows at least 14).
Other name trees (AP, JavaScript, Pages, Templates, IDS, URLS), SubmitForm /Fields, embedded file content, Type3/pattern text, GoToE /T target dictionaries are not covered (proof hits).
The inline-image classification reads the BI dictionary operands; a malformed filter entry blocks as 'inline:filter_entry'.
Proof text matching is case-sensitive exact spelling over the ToUnicode text, like the byte scan.

decisions: Name-tree keys are identifiers nothing in the file refers to: renamed like the embedded-file names (no reference rewrite needed). The values (script code) are not text slots and stay not covered; sanitize_full_rewrite drops JavaScript on request.

SubmitForm/ResetForm /Fields strings are field names: replacing them changes which fields the action targets (the redaction intent wins); they share the form_labels flag. Indirect references inside /Fields are untouched.

An attachment is not text we can edit: a match in its decoded bytes drops the whole /EF (and /RF) of the file specification; an attachment that cannot be decoded is Unverifiable (kept, report incomplete), never silently dropped or assumed clean.

Embedded content is matched as UTF-8 (BOM-aware) and Latin-1 in 1 MiB windows with 4 KiB overlap; UTF-16 without a byte-order mark and attachments inside compressed containers (zip, docx) are not read, by the redaction or by the byte-level payload proof (a needle compressed inside an attachment's own container is out of reach of both).
